purpose: Plan 064 coverage-led expansion of the immutable publication-critic-v7 base into a directly consumable full logical release

base_release.lineage_rule: Every inherited v7 scenario, packet, supervision row, pair and candidate split remains canonically identical; the v7 directory itself is never rewritten.

source_allowlist.allowed_projection: author-created public Scenario blueprints and PublicationPacket fields only

release_layout.formal_release_gate: The formal directory and manifest may be created only after explicit plan-author freeze approval for the exact prefreeze universe identity.

notable_gaps: Long scenarios cover only internal_consistency and honest_uncertainty and only existing-event classes.
Unseen-test has no unavailable-continuity scenario and only one conversational and one Unicode scenario.
Neither holdout contains an Evidence-present-without-omission scenario.
All 72 candidate summaries are Chinese; English and natural mixed-language expression are absent.
Only six mixed singletons and six Within-PASS pairs exist; every v7 Within-PASS pair uses directness_and_lower_repetition.
Several hard-focus-conditioned surface forms are repeated even though the global shortcut checks pass.

sparse_requirements: Every meaningful hard-focus by publication-class cell reaches at least four scenario groups and at least two distinct defect or success manifestations; conditional_continuity applies only to incomplete classes.
Each split contains at least two Boundary scenario groups for every hard dimension.
Every hard dimension gains both short and long Boundary examples without making length predictive of label.

Validation and unseen-test each gain conversational and formal, Unicode and non-Unicode, continuity-unavailable, Evidence present, omitted and none where semantically applicable, and PASS/REWRITE natural mixed examples.
New scope, uncertainty, continuity, consistency and usefulness examples deliberately break v7-conditioned surface cues instead of reusing a negative template.
Within-PASS adds at least four truthful soft-preference families beyond directness_and_lower_repetition.
coverage_contract.anti_cartesian_rule: Use sparse product-shaped cases that close real gaps; do not manufacture a full Cartesian matrix or cosmetic equality.

bounded_scale.floor_derivation: v7 72 plus at least 48 new Boundary scenarios (96 endpoints), 24 natural mixed singletons and 12 Within-PASS third endpoints
bounded_scale.target_derivation: v7 72 plus a working envelope of 60 new Boundary scenarios, 30 mixed singletons and 15 Within-PASS third endpoints
bounded_scale.hard_cap_derivation: v7 72 plus at most 72 new Boundary scenarios, 36 mixed singletons and 18 Within-PASS third endpoints
bounded_scale.quality_attrition_rule: Quality exclusions do not have to be replaced verbatim. Stop at or above the floor as soon as all coverage and quality gates pass; never generate merely to fill the target or cap.

plan060_formal_facts.accepted_sources: Only results merged to main or a formal user/reviewer handoff.

bounded_scale.budget_qualification: Until formal Plan 060 throughput and cost facts arrive, the scale is coverage-bounded only and training-budget suitability remains evidence-insufficient.

split_contract.base_assignments: Pin all 72 v7 candidates to their frozen 42/16/14 splits.
split_contract.new_to_base_rule: A new component touching exactly one v7 component inherits that component's split. A component touching multiple distinct v7 components or multiple frozen splits is rejected or repaired.

holdout_purpose.validation: Stable development-time threshold and slice comparison without training membership.
holdout_purpose.unseen_test: Final unseen coverage across hard dimensions and natural surfaces without training or tuning membership.

split_contract.consumer_default: Physically materialize train membership only; holdout access requires an explicit evaluation path.

hard_focus_publication_class_cells.semantic_manifestation_check: The direct batch reviews and final stratified audit verify at least two genuinely distinct success/failure manifestations per meaningful cell; this semantic distinction is not inferred from labels alone.

length_bucket_contract.responsibility: Scenario-scoped; every candidate endpoint must exactly inherit its Scenario length_bucket
length_bucket_contract.coverage_source: exact-tokenizer total token_count after overflow handling
length_bucket_contract.long_content_rule: four distinct product-shaped prior publications; repeated mechanical filler is forbidden

dedup_contract.automatic_similarity_role: candidate screening and group closure only

shortcut_checks.visible_text_support_policy: Use the larger of eight candidates and four percent of the complete release. This keeps the v7-era support proportion at Plan 064 scale while avoiding release blockers from ordinary English character fragments shared by a small cross-author minority.

review_contract.inherited_v7: Retain v7 terminal review evidence through immutable lineage; do not relabel inherited rows as newly reviewed.
review_contract.new_candidates: Every Plan 064 candidate is directly reviewed independently from generation before admission.
review_contract.new_pairs: Every Plan 064 Boundary and Within-PASS pair is directly reviewed for direction, context, omission and atomicity or soft-only semantics.

audit_sampling.purpose: Additional risk-stratified quality audit only; it never admits an otherwise unreviewed row.
audit_sampling.minimum: All new high-risk, holdout and pair rows are already direct-reviewed; the audit additionally samples every inherited/new release stratum represented in the final universe.

review_contract.finding_rule: A systemic finding is repaired, replaced, downgraded or excluded across the complete affected set and then re-reviewed; do not delete only the sampled example.

mechanical_gates.scope: complete logical v7 plus Plan 064 release
required: strict schema and Plan 054 packet validation
exact and near duplicate checks including Plan 054 references
global and hard-focus-conditioned text, metadata and exact-token length shortcut checks
exact tokenizer census with no overflow or truncation
membership and consumer smoke with default holdout denial
prefreeze universe identity binding rows, review records, design, Plan 054 input identity and reports

stop_conditions: The logical release contains at least 204 candidates.
Every sparse coverage requirement passes after quality exclusions.
All new candidates and pairs have direct terminal review and the stratified audit has no unresolved systemic finding.
A reproducible prefreeze checkpoint exists and the worktree is clean.
no_go_conditions: The hard cap of 270 is reached while a required coverage cell or systemic quality finding remains unresolved.
v7 lineage or fixed holdout identity cannot be preserved.
Known group leakage, reference failure, duplicate/shortcut blocker, token overflow or consumer failure remains.
Direct review does not converge without weakening qualification or pair semantics.
evidence_insufficient_conditions: Formal Plan 060 throughput, cost or training-budget facts remain unavailable for scale qualification.
The data gates pass but a required external training-budget conclusion is requested before formal Plan 060 evidence arrives.

phase_gate.approval_binding: Explicit plan-author approval must name the exact prefreeze universe identity. Any semantic, label, pair, group/split, set, scale or Plan 054 input identity change invalidates approval.
